```{r}
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
savior_names <- read_rds("https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/BoM_SaviorNames.rds")

scripture <- read.csv("https://github.com/beandog/lds-scriptures/raw/master/csv/lds-scriptures.csv")

View(savior_names)
View(scripture)
```


```{r}
BOM <- scripture %>%
mutate(word_count = str_count(scripture_text, " ") + 1) %>% 
  filter(volume_id == 3) %>% 
  pull(scripture_text) %>% 
  paste(collapse = " ")

View(BOM)
```


```{r}
savior_text <- savior_names %>%
  arrange(desc(nchar(name))) %>%
  pull(name) %>%
  str_c(collapse = "|")

bom_text <- scripture %>%
  filter(volume_id == 3) %>%
  pull(scripture_text) %>%
  str_c(collapse = " ")

combined <- str_split(bom_text, savior_text)[[1]]

length(combined)
```

```{r}
words_between <- tibble(text_between = combined) %>%
  mutate(words = str_count(text_between, "\\w+"),
    section_number = row_number()) %>%
  filter(section_number != 1,
    section_number != n())
```

```{r}
average_words_between <- mean(words_between$words)
median_words_between <- median(words_between$words)

average_words_between
median_words_between
```
```{r}
ggplot(words_between, aes(x = words)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 170)) +
  theme_bw()
```
